boundary / image source / finite domain.rule: All four standard methods idealise the domain as unbounded (integration to infinite drop size, no ground, no lid, an infinitely large enclosure), so the failure is the infinite-domain geometric idealisation meeting a real finite boundary.

instrument convention.rule: Each standard method takes the instrument's reported quantity as the physical quantity, when it is actually referenced to a different convention or datum (plane-irradiance cosine weighting, a velocity known only modulo the Nyquist interval, sonic temperature instead of air temperature), so the error is a mismatch of reference definition.
